name: Axium Packaging CA Plant
old_description: With unrivaled engineering expertise, in-house design and tool shops, and uniform equipment platforms across 22 manufacturing sites, Axium reduces development and shipping lead-times from weeks to days.
about:
Axium Packaging’s California plant operates in Ontario, a facility opened in 2013 as part of a company founded in 2010 by the Judge Family Group. The business began with a bottle manufacturing launch in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, and is led by CEO Pushminder Judge and President Paul Judge. Ownership remains with the Judge family, and the company holds minority-certified status.

The plant produces rigid plastic packaging using extrusion blow molding, injection stretch blow molding, injection blow molding, injection molding, and tube extrusion, supplemented by decoration and finishing services. Across the network, Axium runs 33 facilities totaling more than 4.7 million square feet of manufacturing space with a workforce exceeding 3,500. The integrated platform includes in-house design studios, 3D modeling, and tool shops that support concept-to-shelf development.

Customers span personal care and beauty, healthcare and nutraceuticals, food, beverage and spirits, and home and fabric care. The company serves multinational brands such as Unilever, Procter & Gamble, L’Oréal, Bath & Body Works, and Diageo, often through near-site manufacturing arrangements that shorten supply chains.

Axium differentiates itself with a speed-to-market model that cuts traditional lead times in half, a vertically integrated recycling subsidiary (Vertix) that supplies post-consumer recycled resin, and a unified quality system built on GFSI FSSC 22000 V6 standards across all sites.
